title: Millet noodles swap
caption:
Kids love noodles. Make the pack a better one 🍜

Our millet noodles are made with kodo, pearl, barnyard or little millet instead of mostly refined flour. Millets bring more fibre and natural minerals, and keep tummies full for longer.

Cook them just like regular noodles with veggies and a little cold-pressed oil.

👉 ₹54 a pack, 4 millet varieties
